title: Turkish Plural Suffixes (-lar / -ler)
summary: Forming plurals using 2-way Major Vowel Harmony.
explanation: Add '-lar' if the last vowel is a back vowel (a, ı, o, u), and '-ler' if it is a front vowel (e, i, ö, ü).

example_translations.ex_tr_pl_1: There are books on the table.

common_error_explanations.err_tr_pl_1: Do not attach '-ler' to words containing back vowels.
